scope: Every active directory-only or unavailable primary link found in the current data, plus known incorrectly classified third-party references.
rankingRule: Verified seller websites first; seller catalogs next; verified owner-managed social pages next; directory-only and unconfirmed websites last. Directory evidence is not an official seller website.
